goal: Plugin-style dataset architecture. Adding a new dataset requires a single-line addition to dataset_registry.py. Classifier training iterates the registry. Aggregation helper ready for future evaluate.py integration. Baseline preserved at combined=0.742.

stories.title: Remove GPD silent fallbacks; caller-side policy
dataset_registry.py with Dataset dataclass + DATASETS list
acceptanceCriteria: File dataset_registry.py exists at repo root
Exports Dataset dataclass (frozen) with fields: id (str), path (Path), eval_weight (float), train_weight (float)
Exports DATASETS: list[Dataset] with exactly 3 entries: singing (eval=1, train=0 since singing uses pregenerated patches), korean (eval=1, train=1), english (eval=1, train=1)
Paths resolve via `Path(__file__).resolve().parent` (project root) so the module is importable from any cwd
Sanity: `uv run python -c 'from dataset_registry import DATASETS; print([d.id for d in DATASETS])'` prints ['singing', 'korean', 'english']
Each dataset path exists (or points at an optional directory — import succeeds even if one is missing)

stories.title: ml_eval.py iterates DATASETS for classifier training patches
acceptanceCriteria: Hardcoded _KOREAN_SPLICE_DIR and _ENGLISH_SPLICE_DIR constants removed from ml_eval.py
ml_eval.py imports DATASETS from dataset_registry
Speech-patch loader iterates datasets with train_weight > 0, calls _load_speech_splice_patches(str(ds.path), ds.id) for each
Behavior preserved: full eval combined == 0.742 ± 0.01
DIAG output still shows per-language labels (ml.korean, ml.english) — no regressions in observability

stories.title: aggregate_combined helper in dataset_registry.py
acceptanceCriteria: dataset_registry.py exports aggregate_combined(per_dataset: dict[str, float], method: str = 'geometric', floor: float = 0.01) -> dict
method supports: 'geometric', 'mean', 'min'
Returns dict with keys: combined, combined_mean, combined_min, per_dataset
Geometric mean uses max(v, floor) per value to avoid zero-collapse
Inline self-test in __main__: for input {'s': 0.738, 'k': 0.25, 'e': 0.05} with method='geometric' + floor=0.01, returned combined is within 0.001 of hand-computed value (≈ 0.227)
Self-test also covers method='mean' and method='min'

stories.title: evaluate.py integration patch documented for user
acceptanceCriteria: File .omc/evaluate_integration.md documents the exact change-set for evaluate.py: (a) iterate DATASETS for per-dataset eval, (b) optional classifier pass per dataset, (c) call aggregate_combined and print combined_<id>, combined_mean, combined_min, combined at end
Document shows the replacement block for the current Korean-only secondary eval (lines ~519-532 in evaluate.py) with explicit before/after
Document includes proposed new .omc/coordination/baseline_metrics.json value with a brief rationale (metric semantics change)
Document is standalone readable — user can apply without agent context
